scripts.test:knowledge: node --check tara-knowledge-engine.js && node -e "const k=require('./tara-knowledge-engine'); if(!k.answer('What is P/E ratio?').found || k.answer('What is P/E ratio?').educational!==true) process.exit(1); console.log('Knowledge engine OK')"
scripts.test:sentiment: node --check news-sentiment.js && node -e "const s=require('./news-sentiment'); if(s.scoreText('record profit growth').label!=='POSITIVE'||s.scoreText('loss decline').label!=='NEGATIVE'||s.scoreText('company update').label!=='NEUTRAL') process.exit(1); console.log('Sentiment engine OK')"
